_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Written for Raptor.
name: Wiki.js
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Wiki.js is a wiki with a visual and Markdown editor, search, and fine-grained permissions. The egg runs it on a PostgreSQL database, such as one of Raptor's managed databases.
startup: h=$( (node --version; cat wiki/backend/package-lock.json) | sha256sum | cut -d" " -f1); if [ "$h" != "$(cat wiki/backend/node_modules/.raptor-installed 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo "Installing Wiki.js's dependencies"; (cd wiki/backend && npm ci --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund --no-update-notifier --no-progress --loglevel=error) && npm cache clean --force --no-update-notifier --loglevel=error && echo "$h" > wiki/backend/node_modules/.raptor-installed || exit 1; fi; if [ "${UPDATE_CHECK}" = 1 ]; then export WIKI_OFFLINE=false; else export WIKI_OFFLINE=true; fi; export NODE_ENV=production CONFIG_FILE=/home/container/config.yml; cd wiki || exit 1; exec node --no-experimental-webstorage backend

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Wiki.js: downloads the release for the chosen version from GitHub
# (checked against GitHub's checksum) into wiki/, replaced only once the new
# one is complete. Its dependencies are installed when the server starts.
# The wiki itself lives in its PostgreSQL database; data/ (caches, uploads
# waiting to be stored) and config.yml are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
rm -rf .raptor-new
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

want="${VERSION:-latest}"
want="${want#v}"
tag=$(gh-release tag requarks/wiki "$want") || fail "Wiki.js has no version $want. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 3.4.0, then reinstall."
version="${tag#v}"
case "$version" in
    3.*) ;;
    *) fail "This egg runs Wiki.js 3 and later (Wiki.js $version needs a different setup). Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 3.4.0." ;;
esac

if [ -f wiki/backend/package.json ] && [ "$(jq -r .version wiki/backend/package.json)" = "$version" ]; then
    echo "Wiki.js $version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading Wiki.js $version"
    gh-release download requarks/wiki "$tag" wiki-js.tar.gz "$work/wiki.tar.gz"
    mkdir .raptor-new
    tar -xzf "$work/wiki.tar.gz" -C .raptor-new
    [ -f .raptor-new/backend/index.ts ] && [ -f .raptor-new/backend/package-lock.json ] || { rm -rf .raptor-new; fail "Wiki.js's release didn't have the app where it should. Report this to Raptor."; }
    rm -rf wiki
    mv .raptor-new wiki
fi
mkdir -p data

# A first config.yml: the database from the egg's variables (read when
# Wiki.js starts), data in data/. Your own settings can go here too.
if [ ! -f config.yml ]; then
    cat > config.yml <<'YAML'
# Wiki.js settings: https://docs.requarks.io
# $(NAME) is read from the server's variable of that name at every start.
port: $(SERVER_PORT)
bindIP: 0.0.0.0

db:
  host: $(DB_HOST)
  port: $(DB_PORT)
  user: $(DB_USER)
  pass: $(DB_PASS)
  db: $(DB_NAME)
  schema: wiki
  ssl: $(DB_SSL)
  sslOptions:
    auto: true

# true: no update checks or locale downloads (Raptor sets it from Update check).
offline: $(WIKI_OFFLINE)

logLevel: info
logFormat: default
dataPath: /home/container/data
YAML
    echo "Wrote a first config.yml (database from the egg's variables)."
fi
echo "Installed Wiki.js $version."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Wiki.js version to install, such as 3.4.0, or latest. Reinstall to change it.

variables.name: Database host
variables.description: The PostgreSQL server's address, such as the host of a managed database.

variables.name: Database name
variables.description: The database Wiki.js keeps the wiki in.

variables.name: Database user
variables.description: The user Wiki.js signs in to the database as.

variables.name: Database TLS
variables.description: Set it to true to connect to the database over TLS.

variables.name: Admin email
variables.description: The administrator account created when the wiki is first set up.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: The administrator's password, used when the wiki is first set up. Change it later in Wiki.js.

variables.name: Update check
variables.description: Set it to 1 to let Wiki.js check GitHub for new versions and download translations.
